localScope.notEstablished: Independent review, runtime/native/device acceptance, exhaustive semantic or lexical coverage and historical shape derivation.

authorInspection.webScope: Direct Digital Daijisen character and noun headings on Weblio were inspected as specified below. Summaries are original author notes, not copied dictionary entries. Aggregated Wikipedia, name lists and later unrelated dictionaries are not used to replace the frozen metadata.

卓.characterEvidence: A table or raised stand, and standing out in excellence. Supplemental ショク has offering-table/tea and dining-table uses; it is not part of frozen タク-only metadata.
卓.lexicalEvidence: 食卓 1358530; 卓 1415580, with counter sense restricted to たく and Buddhist offering-table/incense-burner senses restricted to しょく; 卓越 1415590; 卓球 1415610; 卓上 1415660, including separate abbreviated speech sense; 卓抜 1415690.
卓.metadataCaution: Classical radical is 十 24; Nelson 25 and the visible upper 卜 do not replace it.

厄.characterEvidence: Calamity and adverse fortune; the noun can abbreviate an unlucky year. The old smallpox sense is recorded in the separate noun entry, not ordinary modern advice or medical causation.
厄.lexicalEvidence: 厄 1537810; 厄介 1537820, trouble and separately care/dependence; 厄災 1537870; 厄年 1537910, traditional unlucky year and bad year; 厄払い 1537930 has やくばらい/やくはらい. Age beliefs are not predictions of harm.

宙.characterEvidence: Sky/open air/midair; 宙で can mean from memory/by heart. Historical チウ and modern song/name spellings elsewhere on the page do not change selected チュウ.
宙.lexicalEvidence: 宇宙 1171300; 宙返り 1426110; 宙に浮く 1893710, literal floating and unresolved/undecided; 宙 1956660, space and by heart; 宙ぶらりん 2272370, suspended and pending, with rare spelling 中ぶらりん.
宙.additionalEvidence: The complete Daijisen 宇宙 heading and supplement explicitly attribute the spatial 宇 / past-to-present temporal 宙 account to Huainanzi, Qisu xun. This is a classical account, not a modern clock-time replacement or proof of the glyph's origin.
宙.unusedFetchLimit: Only the opening encyclopedia portion of Kotobank 宇宙-34804 was read; its later cosmology sections are not claimed inspected or used.

寸.characterEvidence: One tenth of a shaku (about 3.03 cm in the standard unit), length and a tiny amount. Supplemental historical き and an old specific payment-unit use are not selected modern readings or generic fee meanings.
寸.lexicalEvidence: Distinct 一寸 families: 1163930 いっすん, one sun/little bit; 1163940 usually-kana ちょっと with rare kanji spelling and restricted no-kanji variants. 寸暇 1373700; 寸前 1373750; 寸法 1373810, dimensions and plan/arrangement; 寸分 1700300, すんぶん/すんぷん; 寸 1956530. Do not allocate ちょっと to a regular single-character reading.

康.characterEvidence: Physical soundness, peace/safety and a separate broad-road sense. Supplemental やすい/やすらか and historical カウ do not replace frozen コウ.
康.lexicalEvidence: 健康 1256170 noun health and na-adjectival healthy/sound/fit; 小康 1348080 lull/respite and medical remission/stability; 小康状態 2132790 reduced activity/stable condition. Neither 康 nor 康健 had an exact query match; no standalone lexical family is fabricated.

憲.characterEvidence: Fundamental rules, a constitution, and regulation/official use in 憲兵 or 官憲. Supplemental のり is not selected metadata.
憲.lexicalEvidence: 違憲 1158900; 憲兵 1257580; 憲法 1257590 includes constitution and rules/regulation, with obsolete けんぼう separately flagged; 立憲 1551630 includes constitutionalism and an abbreviated political-party sense. No exact standalone 憲 entry was found.

漠.characterEvidence: A sandy expanse, vastness and indistinctness. The separate adjective can be vast or vague; a shared desert context is not a universal sand-only definition.
漠.lexicalEvidence: 広漠 1278640 with rare 宏漠; 漠然 1475790 taru/to vague or indistinct; 砂漠 1593800 with rare 沙漠; 漠 2843550 taru/to vague and vast. Preserve grammar and do not call every desert hot or sandy.
漠.metadataCaution: Water radical 水 85 appears as 氵; KanjiVG records 莫 on the right. No historical phonetic claim is inferred solely from its phon attribute.

監.characterEvidence: Watching/regulating, a supervising role/official and a prison. Supplemental ケン/ゲン and historical roles are distinct from the selected カン-only metadata.
監.lexicalEvidence: 監禁 1213610; 監視 1213680; 監督 1213720, supervision and responsible person; 監査/鑑査 1590860; archaic 監 げん 2580300, Nara administrative division and Dazaifu official. Do not transfer historical offices into an unrestricted modern job title.

督.characterEvidence: Watch/regulate and press someone to carry out an action. Supplemental かみ and the irregular written word 基督 are not selected readings.
督.lexicalEvidence: 監督 1213720, shared complete family; 総督 1401750 with search-only 總督; 督促 1455390 urge/demand; 督励 1455400 encouragement/urging. No standalone 督 family was found.

票.characterEvidence: A written slip or ballot, votes and their counter. Counter/compound changes to びょう/ぴょう do not add basic metadata readings.
票.lexicalEvidence: 開票 1202910 counts ballots; 伝票 1442410 slip/ticket/voucher; 投票 1447320 voting; 得票 1454610 votes obtained; 票 1489320 vote/counter and label/ticket/tag/stub.
票.metadataCaution: Classical radical 示 113 is retained; Nelson 146 and upper 覀 are separate shape/index data.

紀.characterEvidence: Ordered rules, recording/chronicles, chronological reckoning and geological periods. One 紀 can also be twelve years in its own expression; 世紀's hundred years are not a universal single-character value. Supplemental のり/しるす and proper-name readings are not selected metadata.
紀.lexicalEvidence: 紀元 1222910 era/CE; 紀行 1222940 travelogue; 紀要 1222960 bulletin/memoirs; 規律/rare 紀律 1223120 discipline and rules; 世紀 1373990 century/era/of the century; 紀 2205760 geological period and separate historical abbreviations. Do not broaden a historical abbreviation into a modern general meaning.

索.characterEvidence: Rope/cord, seeking by clues and a separate dispersed/empty sense in 索然/索漠. Supplemental もとめる and the irregular 索麺 spelling do not change frozen サク.
索.lexicalEvidence: 検索 1257900; rope 索 1298310; 索引 1298320 with search-only 索隠; 索道 1298380 cableway; 捜索 1399690 missing-person/item search and legal search. Separate mahjong counter 索 2833466 is ソー/ソウ, not サク and not a new basic metadata reading.
索.metadataCaution: Classical radical 糸 120; Nelson 24 and upper 十 are preserved separately.

維.characterEvidence: Fundamental ties, cord/fiber, holding together, corners and a classical function word これ. 維新 illustrates the function-word use, not a literal instruction to tie new objects. Supplemental ユイ/つなぐ/これ are not selected metadata.
維.lexicalEvidence: 維持 1158450; 維新 1158470 renewal, Meiji Restoration and party abbreviation; 繊維/線維 1391890, with 線維 restricted by usage note to medical contexts; complete これ family 1628530, where 維 is a rare spelling and the senses retain kana/formal/dated/archaic flags.

賃.characterEvidence: Money paid for labor or use/provision of things: fee, rent, wages or fare. Distinguish payment from the action and direction of lending/renting.
賃.lexicalEvidence: 運賃 1172820 passenger fare and freight rates; 家賃 1192270 rent; 賃金/rare 賃銀 1431990, ちんぎん and ちんきん (latter restricted to 賃金, with rental-payment sense restricted to that reading); 賃借 1432000 renting from; 賃貸 1432030 renting out; 賃 2844192 charge/payment.
賃.selectedWord: 家賃 uses native や plus on-reading チン; its existing mixed-reading explanation is retained.

魔.characterEvidence: Malign or misleading supernatural forces, enchantment/magic and an obsession-related use. The Buddhist Mara explanation and Sanskrit transcription are lexical history, not evidence that every modern use is religious or that 麻 plus 鬼 is a semantic etymology.
魔.lexicalEvidence: 悪魔 1152510 includes generic demon/devil plus separate Christian Satan and Buddhist Mara senses; 魔術 1524130 includes sorcery and stage magic with large props; 魔物 1524220 monster/spirit; 魔法 1524230; 魔 1633990 includes demon, obsessive-person suffix and dreaded modifier; 魔が差す 1640830 temptation. Do not equate every magic act with moral evil.
魔.metadataCaution: Classical radical 鬼 194, not Nelson 麻 200. The canonical SVG has twenty-one paths.
